text:
- **Owner question replies:** Ask-tool questions can now be answered on the site or in chat; the first answer wins. Owner replies reach a session by push alone.
- **Check and test reliability:** The AGENTS.md check now gives the same verdict on every rerun, and its CI jobs run faster. The Go end-to-end test now passes on every run.
- **Session hooks and settings:** pm no longer installs a git hook or owns the git hooks path. Claude Code auto memory is now off in this repo.
